name: Prefix sum (new result array)
space: O(n) for the result, O(1) extra
whenToUse: The standard answer, and the base of the prefix-sum pattern: the same result array later answers "sum of nums[l..r]" questions with one subtraction. nums stays as it is.

card.signals: "running sum" and runningSum[i] = sum(nums[0]…nums[i]): every answer is the answer before it plus one new number.
card.pattern: a prefix-sum array. One index i walks nums once from left to right and fills result[i] from result[i − 1]. O(n) time.
card.coreIdea: result[0] = nums[0]. For every next i: result[i] = result[i − 1] + nums[i]. result[i − 1] already holds the sum of nums[0..i − 1], so adding nums[i] once gives the sum of nums[0..i].
card.variant: inclusive prefix sum. result[i] includes nums[i] itself, so result has the same length as nums. There is no leading 0 (sentinel): that version, with length n + 1, is for range sums like sum(l, r) = pre[r + 1] − pre[l]. This problem has no ranges, so the plain inclusive array is the answer itself.

invariant: For every written slot j ≤ i: result[j] = nums[0] + nums[1] + … + nums[j].

legend.text: slot of result not written yet (dashed)
result[i − 1] and result[i]: the two slots in the formula
